changelog: The Map Editor jump now lands in the REAL building editing view (Joshua's hands-on findings on 2.0.5, 2026-10-25). (1) THE LANDED TAB CAN EDIT: the building's own tab opened by the jump now carries the same edit controls as opening the building by hand — East-West / North-South position, Width, Depth and Height number fields (typing applies at once), Move / Resize and Delete — driving the same zonedata apply path and the same manifest-safe save. In 2.0.5 the tab was a viewer: no fields, nothing to grab hold of. (2) DETAIL EDIT button, on the landed tab and in the Zone tab's edit row: writes the suite handoff (open-in-detail-editor.json in the shared suite folder: target building, zone, index, geometry) and launches the Detail Editor when installed; when it is not installed a plain dialog says so and the handoff is still written. KNOWN LIMIT: Detail Editor 1.1.0 accepts roads only — its building receiver is a separate queued build; this ships the button and the handoff contract so that build plugs straight in. (3) PART SELECTION in the 3D view: a plain click on the building selects the part clicked — the roof, the front face, or an edge — names it in the readouts and highlights the roof/front in the picture; a click on empty ground clears it. (4) ROOF MOVE with a threshold: a press-and-hold drag starting on the roof moves the building in the ground plane (X/Z only, base stays seated), but only once the pointer has travelled past the drag threshold — a press that stays put is a click and never nudges the building. (5) ROTATE THE BUILDING WITH THE MOUSE: Ctrl+press ON the building and drag turns the building around its own centre, following the mouse (half a degree per horizontal pixel), with a live degrees readout over the view while turning; a Rotation field in both edit rows shows the final angle and accepts a typed angle. Ctrl+drag starting anywhere else still rotates the VIEW exactly as before. HOW ROTATION IS STORED: a zone building's record has no angle field — the footprint is the detail record's ring and the box is the summary. A rotation bakes like every editor transform: the ring turns rigidly about the building's centre and the box becomes the rotated footprint's bounding summary (centre unchanged, width and depth grown symmetrically), saved through the same manifest-safe path (buildings.json + buildings_detail.json + detail chunks + regenerated index). GAME LIMIT, stated plainly: the game places mass buildings from the box and derives each building's facing from the roads at runtime — it reads no per-building angle — so a rotation is exact in the editor's footprint record and views, and takes effect in the game through the new bounding box while the game keeps facing the building to its street.
